title: Frida Kahlo's Life In Reverse, From the Last Canvas to the First #Shorts
description:
Frida Kahlo's life is told backwards in this episode, opening at the blue house in Coyoacan where she died in July 1954 and rewinding through the paintings, the marriages and the operations to her birth in the same house in 1907. The journey steps through her first solo exhibition of 1953, the teaching post she held from 1943, the divorce and remarriage with Diego Rivera, and the bus accident of 1925 that put her in bed with a mirror and a canvas. Every scene moves to an earlier year, so the pictures appear in reverse order and the body behind them becomes clear. Dates, places and titles follow the documented record, and the accounts that disagree over her death are named as disputed.

scenes.narration: She painted herself back together after a bus accident broke her spine, and collectors now pay millions for those canvases.
Step backwards and Frida Kahlo lies on a bed in her own gallery at her first solo exhibition in Mexico City.
Earlier she is divorcing a famous muralist in 1939 and painting two versions of herself sitting side by side.
Before that she is a schoolgirl in Mexico City, one of only a few dozen girls let into a national preparatory school.
At the start there is a child in a blue house with a photographer father who catches polio at the age of six.
